DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 案内図をご覧ですね。どの入口から歩き始めるご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are looking at the map, I see. Which entrance do you plan to start walking from?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この入口から少し歩いて、同じ場所へ戻りたいです。後で友人とここで会う約束があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人と会うため同じ入口に戻る短い散歩を希望すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like a short walk from this entrance and to return here. I am meeting a friend here later.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want a short walk returning to the same entrance to meet your friend. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 戻る時刻が決まっているのですね。散歩で避けたい道はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: So you have a set return time. Are there any paths you would like to avoid?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日は長い坂を歩きたくありません。平らな道を少しだけ歩くつもりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 長い坂を避け平らな道を短く歩きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I do not want to walk up a long slope today. I plan to walk just a little on level ground.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want a short walk on flat ground, avoiding long slopes. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの案内図には、池までの道と丘への道があります。池の道を往復する案はどうでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: This map shows a path to the pond and one to the hill. How about walking out and back along the pond path?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 往復なら分かりやすそうです。途中で座れる場所の目印も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 往復の案を受け入れ途中で座る場所の目印を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Out and back sounds easy to follow. Please also tell me a landmark for somewhere to sit along the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Accept the out-and-back plan and ask for a landmark for a seat on the way. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 池の手前に休憩場所の印があります。歩き始める前に、現地の表示も確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is a resting-place mark before the pond. Before you start, let us check the signs on site too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: もし休憩場所まで行かずに戻りたくなったら、来た道を引き返してもよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 休憩場所へ着く前に来た道を引き返す案を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: If I want to return before reaching the resting place, may I turn back along the way I came?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check whether you can turn back along the same path before reaching the resting place. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通行できる道か現地で確認し、無理せず引き返しましょう。友人には何時に戻ると伝えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Check on site that the path is open, and turn back without pushing yourself. When have you told your friend you will return?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三十分後です。時間を見ながら歩き、池まで行かなくても約束の入口へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三十分後の約束に合わせ池まで行かなくても入口へ戻ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: In thirty minutes. I will watch the time and return to our agreed entrance even if I do not reach the pond.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will return to the entrance for your meeting in thirty minutes, even without reaching the pond. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 約束の場所を覚えておけば安心ですね。入口の目印を見てから出発してください。それでは、心地よい散歩を。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38207-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Remembering the meeting place will be reassuring. Check the entrance landmark before setting off. Have a pleasant walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 階段の前でお困りのようですね。どちらへ向かっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You seem to be having difficulty by the stairs. Where are you heading?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 出口へ行きたいのですが、荷物が重くて階段を上がれません。段差の少ない道はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 階段を避けて出口へ向かう経路を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to reach the exit, but my luggage is too heavy to carry upstairs. Is there a route with fewer steps?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a route to the exit that avoids stairs. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 案内図で確認しましょう。今いるのはこちらです。目指している出口の名前はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the map. We are here. Do you know the name of the exit you want?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人から「広場側」と言われました。地図には二つの改札があるので、どちらかわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 広場側という情報と二つの改札の迷いを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: My friend said “the plaza side.” There are two ticket gates on the map, so I am not sure which.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the plaza-side information and your uncertainty between two ticket gates. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの図では広場側の改札へ行く通路に昇降機の表示があります。利用状況も確認しますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: This map shows a lift along the passage to the plaza-side ticket gate. I will also check its availability.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 利用できるか確かめていただけると助かります。友人には、到着が少し遅れると連絡しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 昇降機の確認を待ち友人に遅れを連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: It would help if you could check whether I can use it. I will tell my friend I will arrive a little late.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Wait for the lift check and tell your friend about the delay. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認が取れるまで、この広い場所でお待ちください。ほかの方が通れるよう、荷物を足元へ寄せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Wait in this wide area until we can confirm. Could you bring your luggage in close by your feet so others can pass?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、荷物を寄せました。昇降機を降りた後は、どの表示をたどれば改札へ着きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 荷物を寄せてから改札への目印を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I have moved it in. After getting out of the lift, which signs should I follow to the ticket gate?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Move your luggage aside, then ask for the signs leading to the ticket gate. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 広場側改札の表示を見て進んでください。途中で見失ったら、無理に荷物を持ち上げず近くの係員へ声をかけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Follow signs for the plaza-side ticket gate. If you lose them, ask a nearby staff member rather than forcing yourself to lift the luggage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 利用の確認を待ってから進み、広場側改札の表示をたどります。友人にも待ち合わせ場所を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認後に表示をたどり待ち合わせ場所を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait for confirmation before proceeding, then follow the plaza-side ticket gate signs. I will also confirm the meeting place with my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will follow signs after confirmation and check your meeting place. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、昇降機の状況を確認してきます。案内が済むまでこちらでお待ちください。お気を付けてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will check the lift. Please wait here until we finish guiding you. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お引っ越しのご相談ですね。お持ちになった資料を見ながら用件を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss moving. I will ask what you need while looking at the documents you brought.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 転入の手続きを相談したいです。住所をメモしてきましたが、書類と部屋番号が違っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 転入相談で部屋番号が食い違っていることを知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to discuss moving-in registration. I wrote down the address, but the room number differs from the document.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the conflicting room numbers while consulting about moving-in registration. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どちらが正しいか確かめてから記入しましょう。違っている箇所を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us establish which is correct before filling it in. Could you show me the differing part?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: メモには三〇二、契約の控えには三〇三とあります。まだ自信がないので、管理会社に問い合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 正しい番号を管理会社に問い合わせる方針を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: My note says 302 and the contract copy says 303. I am still unsure, so I will ask the management company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will ask the management company for the correct room number. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その確認を待ちましょう。今日は担当窓口で、住所以外に確認できることを先に相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us wait for that confirmation. Today you can first discuss things other than the address with the relevant counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 住所が確定する前でも、私の状況で必要な持ち物について聞いてよろしいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 住所確定前に確認できる必要物を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Even before the address is settled, may I ask what I need to bring in my circumstances?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask what required items can be checked before the address is settled. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当者が状況を伺ってご案内します。お一人のお引っ越しか、同居される方がいるか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will ask about your situation and guide you. Please tell them whether you moved alone or with someone who will live with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一人で引っ越しました。資料のどの欄に家族の情報を書くのかも、担当者に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一人の引越しと家族情報の記入欄を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I moved alone. I also want to ask which field on the form is for family information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Discuss moving alone and the field for family details. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その質問も伝えましょう。未確認の欄には推測で書き込まず、相談時に一緒に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us pass on that question too. Do not guess in unconfirmed fields; check them together during the consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一人で転入する場合の持ち物と家族の欄を相談し、部屋番号は管理会社に確認してから記入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当者への相談と部屋番号の確認を分けて進める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will discuss what to bring for moving in alone and the family field, and enter the room number after checking with the management company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate the consultation with staff from checking your room number. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認する順序が決まりましたね。担当窓口への案内をお渡しします。こちらでのご相談は以上です。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have settled the order of checks. I will give you directions to the relevant counter. That concludes your consultation here. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約についてご相談とのことですが、どのような変更を希望されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss your appointment. What change are you hoping for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 来週の予約が仕事の研修と重なりました。別の日に変えられるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 仕事の研修と重なった受診予約を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Next week's appointment overlaps with work training. I want to ask whether I can move it to another day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss the medical appointment overlapping with work training. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約票を確認しますね。前回、次の受診や検査について何か説明を受けましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me check your appointment slip. Were you told anything last time about your next visit or tests?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ日に検査を受けると言われました。検査の予約も一緒に変えてよいのかわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受診と検査を一緒に変更できるか不明だと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: They said I would have tests the same day. I do not know whether the test appointment can be changed along with the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you are unsure whether the consultation and tests can be changed together. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 診療担当へ確認してから調整しましょう。日程以外に、担当者へ伝えておきたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us coordinate after checking with the medical team. Apart from dates, is there anything you want to tell them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 体調についても相談したいことがあります。受付では詳しく話しにくいので、担当者に直接伝えられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 体調の話を担当者へ直接伝えたいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: There is also something about my health I want to discuss. It is difficult to explain in detail at reception; may I speak directly to the person in charge?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to discuss your health directly with the relevant person. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 話せる場所と担当者を確認します。日程の希望は、研修で来られない時間帯も含めて教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check who can speak with you and where. Please tell us your preferred dates, including times you cannot come because of training.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 研修は午前中なので、午後なら来られる日もあります。空きを決める前に診療担当へ相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 午後の希望を伝え診療担当への確認を優先する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Training is in the morning, so there are some days I could come in the afternoon. I want to consult the medical team before deciding on an available slot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State your afternoon preference and prioritize checking with the medical team. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 午前は難しく、午後を希望されると伝えます。元の予約の扱いも確認が終わるまで、こちらで整理しておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will tell them mornings are difficult and you prefer afternoons. Let us also keep track of your original booking until the checks are finished.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 検査と体調の相談を先にして、元の予約をどうするか確認してから、新しい日時を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 検査と体調の相談後に元の予約と新日時を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will discuss the tests and my health first, confirm what happens to the original booking, and then choose a new date and time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After discussing tests and health, sort out the original appointment and new time. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。担当者へ引き継ぎますので、案内する場所でお待ちください。お話しくださってありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will hand this over, so wait where we direct you. Thank you for telling us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車が見当たらないとのことですね。最後に見たときのことを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You cannot find your bicycle, I understand. Please tell me about when you last saw it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 買い物に行く前に店のそばへ停めました。戻ったら見つからず、どう相談すればよいかと思って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 買い物前後の自転車の状況を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I parked beside the shop before shopping. I could not find it when I returned, and came here to ask what to do.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the bicycle's situation before and after shopping. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 停めた時刻や場所は、どの程度覚えていますか。確かなことから伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: How much do you remember about the time and place you parked? Let us start with what is certain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昼ごろだったのは覚えています。入口の右側だと思いますが、別の入口だった可能性もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昼ごろという記憶と入口の位置の不確かさを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I remember it was around noon. I think it was to the right of the entrance, but it may have been a different entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State your memory of noon and uncertainty about the entrance position. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 場所はまだ曖昧なのですね。車体の特徴がわかる写真や資料はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: The location is still unclear, then. Do you have photos or documents showing the bicycle's features?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 携帯電話に写真があります。青い車体で、前かごの左側にへこみがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 青い車体と前かごのへこみを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: There is a photo on my phone. It is blue and has a dent on the left of the front basket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the blue bicycle and dent in its front basket. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真の特徴を確認しましょう。防犯登録の番号について、手元で確認できるものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check the features in the photo. Do you have anything here to check the crime-prevention registration number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号の控えは家にあります。今は正確な数字を言えませんが、帰宅して確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 番号を推測せず家の控えを確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: The number's copy is at home. I cannot give the exact digits now, but I can check when I get home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will check the copy at home rather than guess the number. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 番号は推測せず、確認できた情報をお知らせください。駐輪場所の管理者から何か案内を受けましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do not guess the number; tell us confirmed information. Has the bicycle parking area's manager given you any information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 管理者にはまだ聞いていません。店の入口を確かめ、移動についての案内がないか尋ね、登録の控えも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 店の入口と移動案内と登録番号を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have not asked the manager yet. I will check the shop entrance, ask about any notices on moved bicycles, and check the registration copy too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the shop entrance, relocation information, and registration number. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 覚えていることと未確認の点が整理できました。追加の情報がわかったら相談時にお伝えください。お帰りはお気を付けて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have sorted out what you remember and what is unconfirmed. If you find further information, tell us when consulting. Take care going home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 書類をお送りになるのですね。送付先から方法の指定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are sending documents. Has the recipient specified a method?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 案内には「記録の残る方法」とあります。追跡番号が付けば、この条件に合うでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 追跡番号で提出先の指示を満たすか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: The instructions say “a method leaving a record.” Does having a tracking number meet that condition?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a tracking number meets the recipient's instructions. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 求められている記録の内容を確かめましょう。配達状況を見ることと、提出先が求める証明は同じとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check what record they mean. Viewing delivery status and the proof the recipient requires are not necessarily the same.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 番号で調べられれば十分だと思っていました。受け取ったことを示す記録も必要なのか、提出先に聞いたほうがいいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受取の記録が必要か提出先へ聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought being able to look it up by number was enough. I should ask the recipient whether a record showing receipt is also needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask the recipient whether a record of receipt is needed. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認できれば選びやすくなります。期限については、到着日か発送日か書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Knowing that will make choosing easier. Does the deadline refer to arrival or sending?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 「期限までに届くこと」と書いてあります。今日出せば間に合うと決めつけず、配達の見込みも聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 到着期限を示し配達見込みを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: It says “must arrive by the deadline.” I do not want to assume sending today is enough; I also want an estimated delivery time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State the arrival deadline and discuss estimated delivery. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 宛先と差し出す条件を確認して、見込みをご案内します。必ずその日に届くというお約束とは分けてお考えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the address and sending conditions and explain the estimate. Please distinguish that from a promise of arrival on that day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 宛先はこちらです。封筒を閉じる前に、提出書類がそろっているか自分でも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 発送前に書類の不足を自分で確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here is the address. Before sealing the envelope, I will check myself that all required documents are included.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check yourself for missing documents before sending. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その後で、確認した送付条件に合う候補を比較しましょう。控えや番号を受け取ったら保管してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: After that, let us compare options meeting the confirmed conditions. Keep the receipt and number when you receive them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 必要な記録を提出先に聞き、書類を点検してから方法を選びます。控えもなくさないよう保管します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 記録の条件を確認して方法を選び控えを残す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask the recipient about the record, inspect the documents, and then choose the method. I will also keep the receipt so I do not lose it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the record requirements, choose a method, and retain the receipt. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご確認が済んだら、封筒と案内をお持ちください。ここで候補を一緒に確認できます。本日はありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: After checking, bring the envelope and instructions. We can review the options together here. Thank you for coming today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座について、今日はどのような使い方をご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: What use of an account would you like to discuss today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 生活費を分けて管理する口座を相談したいです。引っ越したばかりで、身分証の住所はまだ前の住所です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 生活費用口座の希望と旧住所の身分証を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want an account for managing living expenses separately. I have just moved, and my identification still has my old address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State your wish for a living-expenses account and identification with the old address. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の住所と書類の状態を担当者が確認します。住所の更新については、これから手続きをされる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The person in charge will check your current address and documents. Do you plan to arrange the address update?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 来週、更新について相談する予定です。今の書類だけで申し込めると考えてよいのか、先に聞きたくて来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未更新の書類で申込みできるか先に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I plan to ask about updating it next week. I came to first ask whether I may assume I can apply with just my current documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: First ask whether you can apply with documents that are not updated. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な確認が済むまでは、その書類だけで足りると判断できません。別の書類をお持ちかどうかも伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Until the necessary checks are complete, we cannot decide those documents alone are sufficient. May I also ask whether you have other documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 新しい住所が載った契約の控えはあります。ただ、それが使えるかはわからないので担当者に見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新住所の契約控えが使えるか担当者に確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a copy of the contract showing my new address. But I do not know whether it is usable, so I would like the person in charge to see it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask staff to check whether the contract copy with your new address is usable. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書類の種類と内容を確認してお伝えします。原本が必要かなども含め、相談の結果を記録しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the type and contents and tell you. Let us record the consultation results, including whether originals are required.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 原本は家にあります。次に持ってくるものを間違えないよう、書類名と確認が必要な点を書き留めてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 書類名と原本の必要性をメモしたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The original is at home. May I write down the document names and points to check so I do not bring the wrong items next time?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to note document names and whether originals are needed. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、メモして一つずつ確かめてください。住所更新の前後で何を用意するか、まだ決まっていない点も残しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, note and check each item. Let us keep the unsettled points too, including what to prepare before and after updating the address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 使える書類と原本の要否を確認し、住所更新の予定も伝えます。わからない点を残したメモを次の相談に持参します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 住所更新と必要書類の未確定事項を次回へ引き継ぐ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check acceptable documents and whether originals are needed, and explain my address-update plans. I will bring the notes retaining unknown points to my next consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Carry forward unresolved address-update and document requirements to next time. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 準備のための相談として承りました。担当者に引き継ぎますので、書類とメモをお持ちのままお待ちください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood as a consultation to help you prepare. I will refer you onward, so wait with your documents and notes. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 棚の表示についてお困りですか。気になる商品を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are the shelf labels confusing? Please show me the product in question.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この菓子を一袋だけ買いたいのですが、棚の値札が一袋と三袋セットのどちらの値段かわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一袋と三袋セットのどちらの価格か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want just one bag of these sweets, but cannot tell whether the shelf price is for one bag or a set of three.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check whether the price is for one bag or a three-bag set. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 値札の商品名だけでなく、内容量も見比べましょう。お持ちの商品には何袋入りと書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us compare not just the product names on the labels but the quantities too. How many bags does the product you are holding say it contains?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 三袋入りと書かれていました。一袋のつもりで、セットのほうを取ってしまったようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 誤ってセットを手に取ったと認める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It said three bags. I meant to take one but seem to have taken the set.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that you picked up the set by mistake. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらに一袋入りがあります。対象の値札も確認しますので、今のセットは私がお戻ししますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here is the one-bag pack. I will check its price label too, and put back your current set for you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。一袋入りの表示に小さい条件があるようですが、通常の値段とは違うのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通常価格と条件付き価格の違いを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. There seem to be small-print conditions for the one-bag pack. Is that different from the usual price?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the difference between the regular and conditional prices. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 条件を読んで確かめます。対象者や期間などの表示がある場合は、その内容も一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will read and check the conditions. If eligibility or dates are shown, let us check those details too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 条件を満たすかまだわかりません。条件付きの価格と、それ以外の価格を分けて教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 条件に当てはまるか未確定のまま価格を分けて確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do not know whether I meet the conditions yet. Could you tell me the conditional price and the other price separately?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the two prices separately while eligibility remains uncertain. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 両方を確認してご案内します。購入を決める前に、商品の袋数と表示が一致しているかもう一度見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will confirm both and tell you. Before deciding, check again that the number of bags matches the label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一袋入りで間違いありません。自分に適用される価格を確認してから、こちらを買うか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一袋入りと適用価格を確かめて買うか判断する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: It is definitely the one-bag pack. I will check the price applicable to me and then decide whether to buy it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm one bag and the applicable price before deciding to buy. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認できた価格をご案内しますので、少々お待ちください。お買い物のお手伝いができてよかったです。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait a moment while we tell you the confirmed price. I am glad we could help with your shopping. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 案内図をご覧になりますか。今日はどのくらい園内を歩く予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like the map? How long are you planning to walk around the park today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人が来るまで少し散歩したいです。長く歩くと疲れるので、短い道と休める場所を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 短い経路と休憩場所を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like a little walk until my friend arrives. Long walks tire me, so I want to know a short route and a place to rest.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request a short route and a resting place. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 入口近くを回る候補を図で見ましょう。友人との集合場所は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us look at options near the entrance on the map. Have you agreed a meeting place with your friend?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この入口の案内板の前です。別の出口へ出ると行き違いになるので、ここへ戻りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同じ入口へ戻る必要を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: In front of this entrance's information board. If I leave through another exit, we may miss each other, so I want to return here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain why you need to return to the same entrance. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、この図の休憩場所を通って戻る案を考えましょう。途中の道の状態は、今日の掲示も確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let us plan a return route past this resting place. Also check today's notices for conditions along the path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 掲示では一部の道が使えないようです。休憩場所まで行かずに引き返すこともできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通行できない道の掲示を受けて散歩の範囲を見直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: The notice seems to say some paths are closed. Can I turn back before reaching the resting place too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reconsider the walk's extent in light of the notice about closed paths. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通れない道には入らず、開いている区間だけで考えましょう。気になる点は現地の表示でも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do not enter closed paths; consider only the open sections. Check any concerns against signs on site too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は無理に一周しません。疲れたら引き返すとして、帰りもこの案内板を目印にすればよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 疲れたら引き返し案内板を目印に戻る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not force myself to complete a circuit today. If tired I will turn back, using this information board as my return landmark, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will turn back if tired and use the information board to return. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内板と入口の名前を両方覚えておくと確認しやすいです。友人には短い散歩に出ることを伝えておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Remembering both the information board and entrance name makes checking easier. Tell your friend you are going for a short walk too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 入口の名前を控え、友人に散歩へ出ると連絡します。通れる区間だけ歩き、疲れる前に同じ入口へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 入口名を控えて友人に知らせ開いている区間を歩く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will note the entrance name and tell my friend I am taking a walk. I will walk only open sections and return to the same entrance before getting tired.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Note the entrance name, inform your friend, and walk the open sections. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 集合場所に戻る予定も伝えておけば安心ですね。道の表示を確かめながら、ご自分のペースでどうぞ。いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38210-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Telling them your plan to return to the meeting place is reassuring too. Check the path signs and go at your own pace. Enjoy your walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗換案内に印を付けていらっしゃいますね。降りたい駅の名前を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have marked the transfer directions. Could you show me the name of the station where you want to get off?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この案内の東町へ行きたいです。途中に東町口もあり、どちらで降りるのか混乱しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 東町が目的地だが東町口と取り違えそうだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to go to Higashimachi in this guide. Higashimachiguchi is also on the way, so I became confused about where to get off.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that Higashimachi is your destination but you might confuse it with Higashimachiguchi. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この練習用案内では、東町口は乗り換える駅で、目的地は東町です。お手元のメモには何と書いてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this practice guide, Higashimachiguchi is the transfer station and Higashimachi is the destination. What have you written in your note?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 東町口で降りて外へ出る、と書いてしまいました。駅の外へ出ずに乗り換えるという意味ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 東町口で外へ出ると書いたことを伝え改札を出ず乗り換える意味か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I wrote “get off at Higashimachiguchi and go outside.” Does it mean transfer without leaving the station?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you wrote to go outside at Higashimachiguchi and ask whether it means transferring without exiting the ticket gate. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そうです。改札を出る前に乗換表示を確認する流れです。乗り換えた先の列車の行き先も読みましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. You should check the transfer signs before exiting the ticket gate. Let us also read the destination of the train after the transfer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 行き先は北浜とあります。北浜行きに乗って、その途中の東町で降りるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 北浜行きの途中で東町に降りるという理解が正しいか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: It says Kitahama. Do I board a Kitahama-bound train and get off at Higashimachi along the way?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check your understanding of getting off at Higashimachi on the way to Kitahama. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 案内の矢印はその順序を示しています。終点まで乗る必要はありません。メモを二行に分けると見やすくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The guide's arrows show that order. You do not have to ride to the terminus. Splitting your note into two lines will make it easier to read.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一行目は東町口で乗換表示を見る、二行目は北浜行きで東町まで、と書き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 乗換表示を見ることと北浜行きで東町へ向かうことを二行に分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will rewrite line one as “check transfer signs at Higashimachiguchi,” and line two as “Kitahama-bound train to Higashimachi.”
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Separate checking transfer signs and taking a Kitahama-bound train to Higashimachi into two lines. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのメモに、車内の停車駅案内を見ることも加えておくと確認できますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Add checking the train's stopping-station information to that note, and you can verify it too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 降りる前に車内の停車駅案内も見ます。似た名前だけで判断せず、メモの二行を順番に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 車内の停車駅案内とメモの順番を使って似た駅名を確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the stopping-station information inside before getting off. I will not judge by similar names alone, but check the two note lines in order.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will use the on-board stop information and note order to check similar station names. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 出発前には実際の表示をもう一度確かめてください。それでは、どうぞお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38213-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Before setting off, check the actual signs once more. Take care, then.
